Frequently asked questions

How long does a handmade resin order take?

Most pieces ship within 3 to 5 working days. Custom orders take 7 to 10 days because resin needs time to cure.

Do you deliver across Pakistan?

Yes. We deliver across Pakistan and ship worldwide on request.

Can I order a custom design?

Yes. Message us on WhatsApp with your idea, colors and size, and we will send a quote.

How do I care for resin art?

Wipe with a soft damp cloth and keep it out of long direct sunlight and high heat.
